juneIntro.title: Aunt June's porch
paragraphs: On the way to the library, your great-aunt June waves you over. She peeks into your backpack... and smiles. "A hatchling! I looked after a dragon too, when I was your age."
"Now listen carefully. There's a man in town called Silas Crane. He collects rare things and keeps them in glass cases."
"A dragon in a glass case can't stretch its wings, can't grow, and never gets to fly. That's why we keep dragons safe from people like him."
"Crane has helpers: a drone with a red light that never blinks, and people with clipboards who pretend to count birds. He even makes fake websites to find out where dragons live."
"We keep your dragon safe from strangers like Crane. But never from your family: when you're ready, the people who love you can help."
juneIntro.closing: Aunt June is the first member of your Keeper Circle. Now you're not looking after the dragon alone.

eveningIntro.title: Evening at home
paragraphs: {name} is curled up in the nest in your room.
Mom and Dad are downstairs. Your little sibling, Kit, is seven years old and very curious about everything. Kit is still wide awake.

Your family may stop by to say goodnight. A sudden knock can startle a young dragon, like a nesting bird. When you hear footsteps, help {name} stay calm: dim the lamp, hum, or use the blanket if you found the tip.
If anyone in your family asks about the dragon, you can always show them. Family can help keep {name} safe.
And remember Aunt June's warning: watch the window for Crane's helpers. Tap anything suspicious to close the curtains.

steppingStones.title: Whoa, everything at once!
steppingStones.intro: {name}'s tummy is rumbling, Kit is knocking at the door, AND a red light is blinking at the window. Take a deep breath. One stone at a time.

firstFeedback.blink: Closing the curtains first was quick, and it stopped BLINK from seeing anything. Smart thinking!
firstFeedback.hungry: Feeding {name} first calmed it down, which made everything else easier. Good thinking!
firstFeedback.kit: Answering Kit first was kind. BLINK got a quick peek before the curtains closed, but nothing too bad. Next time, the curtains are a quick first step!

steppingStones.after: One stone at a time, everything got sorted. {name} munches a snack behind closed curtains.

kitDiscovers: Kit opens the door... and stares. A little green tail is poking out of the nest! "Is that... a DRAGON?"
